independence: This reviewer did not author the policy, stimuli, rubric, or generated responses. It read the hidden rubric only for assessment. It reviewed source changes and the actual initial transcripts in a separate agent context.
method: Assess meaning and behavior in response strings against the saved initial policy, hidden rubric, and scripted current-turn context. Use decision_state metadata only as a supplementary consistency check; it cannot repair missing user-facing explanations. Dimension evidence is turn-specific. A recommendation for a different later choice cannot repair an earlier omission.
limitations: Scripted user turns are not human comprehension evidence.
Each responding agent reused one context across four reset cases. The run therefore does not provide eight fully independent response contexts.
The response files call those responding contexts evaluator contexts; the actual separate behavioral assessment is this artifact.
No same-stimulus baseline was assessed, so this run cannot measure improvement.
This assessment covers initial responses only. A later focused correction retest must retain separate policy identities, transcripts, and assessment.
No actual project records were written or project actions executed by these responses. Preserved transcript evidence demonstrates stated behavior and limits, not executed record integrity.

A dimension is assessed where the corresponding behavior is exercised. A confirmation that asks no new choice does not require another recommendation; repair is assessed on the confusion exchange and its subsequent acknowledgement.
